notes.title: v1078
notes.content:
[list]
[*]New translation - Hungarian. Special thanks to [url=http://lostprophet.hu/]Zsolt Brechler[/url]!
[*]Improved save game code - more efficient, less error-prone, easier to troubleshoot
[*]Upgrade to Oculus SDK 0.6.0.1-beta
[*]Major edits to [url=http://i.imgur.com/nrBkhcK.jpg]this map[/url]
[/list]

Note: Lemma only supports "extended mode" for Oculus. If you have an AMD graphics card, the new SDK will not work in extended mode. You can still downgrade to 0.5.0.1-beta and everything should work.

notes.title: v1064
notes.content:
Huge patch guys!
[list]
[*]Add an option to minimize camera motion
[*]Disable animated camera rotations in VR mode
[*]Some of the campaign levels are now available in time trial mode
[*]Challenge level leaderboards are now accessible from the main menu
[*]Fix a subtle but nasty bug related to backtracking on Forest and Dawn
[*]Fix "save new" button
[*]Fix wall-run glitch exploit
[*]Add debug player velocity display
[*]Level editor respects movement key bindings
[*]Fix reticle / damage overlay remaining visible during cutscenes
[/list]
